description: This file defines a React context and provider for managing and caching user and session data within a React application. It includes hooks for consuming the context and handles initial data loading, refresh functions, and error/loading states.

methods.name: useDataContext
methods.description: Hook to access the shared DataContext providing user and session data.

methods.name: DataProvider
methods.description: Component that loads and caches user and session data on mount, providing context values and refresh functions.
